title: HRAccount
description: One HR login. NEW in round 4 - replaces the single hardcoded admin/password123 account read from .env. There is no `password` or `password_hash` property anywhere in this schema on purpose: the backend model does not declare the field, so it cannot leak through a careless serialisation.

account_id.description: UUID. Read-only. This is what comment_logs, status_history and resume_versions reference.

username.description: Login handle. Unique. Not editable after creation - history is attributed by account_id anyway.

full_name.description: Displayed as the comment author and snapshotted into every comment at write time.

role.description: Drives the default comment_type and gates the account-management endpoints. 'admin' only for /api/hr-accounts/*.

is_active.description: Accounts are DEACTIVATED, never deleted - a hard delete would orphan or cascade away comment history. A deactivated account is rejected at the NEXT request, not when its token expires.

last_login_at.description: ISO 8601, or null if the account has never logged in.

loginResponse.title: LoginResponse
loginResponse.description: `data` of POST /api/auth/login. BREAKING in round 4: `account` is new. Store it - the frontend needs account_id to decide which comments the current user may edit.

access_token.description: JWT, valid 8 hours. Payload: {sub: account_id, username, name, role, iat, exp}.

accountInfo.title: AccountInfo
accountInfo.description: Also the exact shape of `data` from GET /api/auth/me.

endpoints.description: Not part of the payload - a summary of the API for Lanes A and B.
endpoints.POST /api/auth/login: Public. {username, password} -> loginResponse. 401 with an identical message for unknown user, wrong password and deactivated account. 429 after 5 failures for one username within 15 minutes (Retry-After header).
endpoints.GET /api/auth/me: Any logged-in account -> accountInfo. Call it before rendering comment edit/delete controls.
endpoints.POST /api/hr-accounts: Admin. {username, email, full_name, password, role} -> 201. 409 on a duplicate username or email.
endpoints.DELETE /api/hr-accounts/{account_id}: Admin. SOFT delete - sets is_active=false. Refuses on your own account and on the last active admin.
endpoints.POST /api/hr-accounts/{account_id}/reset: Admin. {new_password} - a temporary password the holder should change immediately.
